CustomField.description: Optional override for the section's completeness predicate. When unset, "complete" is derived from required questions: all required answers are non-blank. Set this when completeness is non-obvious from required-field presence alone (e.g. depends on a combination of values across questions).
CustomField.inlineHelpText: Optional completeness predicate. When set, this evaluates against the IndividualApplication record to determine the section's complete state, overriding the default required-questions-filled rule.
CustomField.label: Complete Criteria
